overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures and exports Bhumi Amla Powder from India for B2B buyers who need bulk herbal ingredients. The powder is made from Phyllanthus niruri and processed as a dehydrated material with an 80-100 mesh size. It is suitable for manufacturers, brands, and distributors looking for consistent supply and custom trade support.

The product is prepared through a controlled 6-step process: sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing and dispatch. TradeNest Naturals is an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter. MOQ starts at 5 Kg, with OEM and private label support, custom mesh and packaging on request, and export documentation support.

faqs.q: What is the MOQ for Bhumi Amla Powder?
Can you support OEM and private label supply?
faqs.a: Yes. OEM and private label supply are available, including small private-label pouches and jars.
We offer 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, 5-10 kg bags, and custom private-label packaging on request.

faqs.q: Do you offer custom mesh size or packaging?
faqs.a: Yes. Custom mesh and packaging are available on request.

faqs.q: What is the shelf life and storage guidance?
faqs.a: Shelf life is 24 months. Store in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and moisture.

faqs.q: Do you provide export support documents?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide export documentation support for B2B shipments.
